items.title: Trump tells allies 'go get your own oil' from Strait of Hormuz
items.description: The US president again attacks America's allies over their reluctance to get involved in the Iran war, warning them the "US won't be there to help you anymore, just like you weren't there for us".

items.title: Iran sets 24-hour deadline on missile threat. Here's what you should know this morning
items.description: US companies including Microsoft, Google and Apple could be targeted, while Donald Trump urges the world to buy American fuel.

items.title: Live: Iranian president says Tehran willing to end war but needs guarantees
items.description: Iran has the "necessary will" to end the war with the United States and Israel, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says, stressing that Tehran is seeking guarantees the conflict will not flare up again.

items.title: Trump tells UK to 'fight for yourself' as king confirms state visit
items.description: US President Donald Trump lashed out at the UK just before the visit was confirmed as France, Spain and Italy restrict airspace to US war planes.

items.title: Public should not expect clear trigger for fuel rationing
items.description: The federal government is not expected to publicly nominate a clear trigger point for fuel rationing, despite internal modelling outlining potential thresholds.

items.title: A recession could happen even without a fuel shortage. Here's how
items.description: The government is urging people to carry on as normal despite fuel shortages, because it knows that panic will make matters worse. But it may need to consider more drastic economic intervention.

items.title: Two shootings, 150km apart: Dezi Freeman's final destination mystifies locals
items.description: The fugitive resurfaced more than 150 kilometres away from the town where he shot and killed two police officers seven months ago. Mystified locals are questioning how.

items.title: Less than half of states signed up as national gun reform deadline passes
items.description: The federal government's March deadline for national gun reform has come and gone, with more than half the states and territories still opposed to parts of the plan. Only four have committed to a gun buyback scheme.

items.title: Live: Motorists may not see cheaper fuel for days or weeks
items.description: Labor says it may take a couple of days, or even weeks if for those living in regions where fuel stocks are not turned over quickly, for the savings from the fuel excise cut to flow through. Follow live.

items.title: 'We'll see more deaths': Experts warn about vaccine decline
items.description: The latest immunisation data shows more than 80,000 Australian children aged five and under are not fully up to date with their vaccinations.

items.title: House prices rise everywhere besides Sydney and Melbourne
items.description: There is a significant divide between property price growth in major cities as buyers weigh up interest rate hikes and geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Why your household could be hit by a bill hike trifecta this month
items.description: Millions of Australian households will be hit with a trifecta of price hikes this month. Here's what to know about the changes and how they could affect you.

items.title: 'Nothing's out here' Vodafone ad angers rural Australians
items.description: A new Vodafone campaign has regional Australians seething after the telecommunications giant claimed to focus its network infrastructure on where "98 whatever per cent of you actually live".

items.title: Mine may be shut down amid money laundering allegations, bikie claims
items.description: The Tasmanian government has taken steps to revoke the operating licence of one of the state's biggest mining operations, after being warned it was allegedly used as a "vehicle for money laundering" and former owners were associated with underworld figures.

items.title: Tiger Woods had opioid pills in pocket at crash scene, police say
items.description: A sheriff's office report says golfer Tiger Woods had hydrocodone opioid pills in his pocket when interviewed at the scene of his car crash in Florida last week.

items.title: Travel quiz: Get out your passport and see if you can beat our quiz
items.description: Which is Australia’s oldest Luna Park? And where would you find Elvis Presley’s mansion?

items.title: Could I be using E10 in my car?
items.description: Australia's leading motoring organisation is urging drivers to fill up with E10 fuel in an effort to conserve national fuel supplies. But what exactly is E10? And could it help ease the current fuel crisis?

items.title: This controversial rom-com starring Zendaya is one of the best movies of the year
items.description: On the surface, A-listers Zendaya and Robert Pattinson's new film seems like a regular rom-com. That's exactly what director Kristoffer Borgli wants you to think.

items.title: Anger at developer's plan to build $10m mansion on illegally cleared land
items.description: A property developer who illegally cut down hundreds of native trees has lodged a new plan to build a lavish $10 million, six-bedroom mansion in Sydney's south.

items.title: One of Australia's biggest 'giveaway' clubs has its licence cancelled
items.description: RS Rewards claims to have given away more than $10 million worth of cars, houses and cash. But its licence has just been cancelled.

items.title: Former royal commissioner casts doubt on antisemitism, Bondi inquiry timeline
items.description: Ronald Sackville who led the disability royal commission says it is unlikely the the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion can properly examine the experiences of Jewish Australians before its December 2026 deadline.

items.title: Shein and Kmart accused of copying Queensland retailer's designs
items.description: Queensland business Sabo Skirt has claimed Shein, Kmart and numerous other retailers and wholesalers have copied its clothing patterns, prints and trademarks on "lower quality" garments in a federal court claim.

items.title: Calls for tourism lease of world heritage area island to be cancelled
items.description: A private developer who wants to build a standing camp on an island in the Tasmanian Wilderness World Heritage Area tells the ABC he has requested another lease extension, amid an outcry from the Tasmanian Greens.

items.title: Free dental clinic changes lives in cost-of-living crisis
items.description: Demand is high for an Adelaide dental program that offers free services to patients who have experienced homelessness or who have trouble accessing conventional care.

items.title: Record month of drownings takes mental toll on rescuers
items.description: Rescuers say the impact of a drowning doesn't end when the sirens stop, with better support now helping them process the shock and grief that can follow.
